## Anderson Tavares

Data analyst. I work in SQL as a first language, model data with dbt, and write
the analysis up so someone who does not write SQL can still follow the argument
and recheck the numbers. Most of my work is on marketplace and operations data,
where the hard part is deciding what a number means.

> **Looking for:** data analyst / data scientist roles.

## What I work with

| Area | Tools |
|---|---|
| Querying & modelling | PostgreSQL, dbt, advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs) |
| Analysis | Python (pandas, matplotlib, seaborn), statistical reasoning |
| Engineering | Git, Docker, pytest, GitHub Actions, `uv` |
| Communication | Quarto, technical writing, decision memos |

## How I work

- **Start from a decision.** Every analysis exists to answer a question someone
  would pay to have answered.
- **Test the data, not just the code.** If an assumption breaks, the build should
  fail loudly.
- **Write the limitations down.** A finding without its caveats is a liability.
